plain.li: Dreamt the whole herd came down off the hill at dusk, more of them than we've ever had, and I knew every one by name.
Lying in long grass in the middle of the herd, and they grazed around me as if I were one of them.
[winter] Dreamt it was spring and the pens were full of young ones, all legs, falling over each other.

warm.li: Walked among the herd at night in my dream, and every one of them was warm and well, breathing slow.

cheerful.li: I dreamt the herd could count, and they counted me in at the gate for a change!

cold.li: Dreamt of the herd at twice its size. I've been working out the feed since.

plain.li: The animals could talk, and they'd been talking about us all along. They weren't impressed.
An old muffalo sat me down and explained, very slowly, everything I'd been doing wrong with the herd.
[child] I dreamt the animals had a council too, and the goat was in charge, and nobody could vote against the goat.

blunt.li: Dreamt the animals talked. Didn't like what the pigs had to say.

gloomy.li: The animals asked me why we keep them. I didn't have an answer.

cold.li: Dreamt the herd discussed its own management. Some of the points were valid.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of something at the pens

plain.li: Dreamt something was moving around the pens in the dark, and I couldn't find the lantern, and the herd was screaming.
In the dream the fence was down and the pens were empty, and there were tracks I didn't recognize leading away into the snow.
[afterraid] Dreamt the raiders came back for the animals. I could hear them and I couldn't move.

warm.li: Couldn't get to the animals in time, in the dream. I went out to the pens before breakfast just to count them.

blunt.li: Bad dream about the pens. Walked the fence at dawn. Nothing.

gloomy.li: Dreamt we lost the whole herd in one night. It felt like a warning.

cold.li: Something got in at the pen's weak corner. Only a dream. I'll reinforce it today.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of an animal that's gone

plain.li: My old companion came back in my dream, young again, and ran ahead of me all the way to the river and waited for me there.
We were walking the old way along the fence, and it kept stopping to sniff at things that aren't there anymore.
[child] My animal came to visit me in my dream. It said it was fine where it is, and there are lots of sticks.

warm.li: Dreamt my old friend pushed its nose under my hand, the way it did when I'd been sitting still too long.

blunt.li: Dreamt about my animal. Good dream. Bad waking up.

gloomy.li: It was there in the dream, waiting by the gate. Then the gate was empty, and so was I.

cold.li: A dream about the animal I lost. I seem to be taking it harder than I let on.

plain.li: I rode on the back of the biggest animal in the world, so high I could see over the walls and all the way to the sea.
I had a horse that could run faster than the wind, and it was mine, and we went everywhere.
[winter] I dreamt I rode through the snow on a great shaggy animal, and I wasn't cold at all.

cheerful.li: I rode a thrumbo in my dream. It was soft and it smelled of hay and it let me hold its horn!

gloomy.li: I was riding, and then I fell off, and the animal kept going without me.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a young animal grown old

plain.li: Dreamt {PET_nameDef} was young again, all legs and noise, tearing around the yard like the day we met.
In the dream {PET_nameDef} and I walked all the way to the far hills without stopping, and neither of us was tired.

warm.li: {PET_nameDef} was a youngster again in my dream, and I got to have all those years over.

gloomy.li: Dreamt {PET_nameDef} was young. Then I woke up and heard the old slow breathing by the bed, and was glad of it anyway.
